title: Chapter 361 Who Says I'M The Only One
content:
Chapter 361 Who Says I'M The Only One

boom!

There was another loud noise.

The Supreme alien race did not have a trace of breath, but it exploded directly on the spot and was wiped out.

A trace of blood filled the air, as if telling everyone that a powerful man in the Supreme Realm had just taken action.

But the other party obviously failed.

Time seemed to be still for a moment, and the tribes stared blankly at Lu Daosheng in the void.

The fearful eyes gradually evolved into fear.

It is not so easy to kill a powerful person in the Supreme Realm even a powerful person in the Heavenly Supreme Realm.

"My bone tribe quit!"

"It's lively, you guys come and take care of me."

A powerful alien with exposed bones suddenly shouted loudly.

After saying that, the powerful men of the Bone Clan present hurriedly fled here.

Although their bone clan is not weak, they are not much stronger. The human clan has the combat power of instant killing the supreme realm, and their bone clan is no longer qualified to stay here.

After the Bone Clan, several other weak races chose to withdraw.

For a moment, only the powerful races in the Chaos Realm were left on the scene.

The golden-eyed creature still stayed there, and there was a hint of fear in his eyes looking at Lu Daosheng.

At this time, the human race's supreme emperor had already stepped out and came to Lu Daosheng's side.

"You are very strong. With you and me here, the human race will be free of worries."

He looked at the powerful men of the tribes around him who had not left, and said in a plain voice.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng turned his head and looked at him.

Feeling Lu Daosheng's captivating gaze, the human race's supreme was also a little unnatural.

"how?"

Lu Daosheng sneered, "Since you said that, then we should be half of each of us."

“…”

"Then what, I was talking about it, you keep going."

After saying that, he hurriedly retreated behind Lu Daosheng.

The faces of the people were a little hot. Why is this Supreme Heaven so thick-skinned? They can't stand it anymore.

Only a small number of people who know this human race's Supreme Heavenly Supreme know that they rely on their thick-skinned and desperate appearance to emerge from countless geniuses and monsters and achieve the Supreme Heavenly Supreme Heavenly Supreme.

When something happened to the human race, he naturally noticed it.

But at that time he was eager to heal his wounds, and even if he came forward, his seriously injured body would have been basically useless.

So he could only keep numbing himself and would definitely avenge the human race in the future.

But what he didn't expect was that Lu Daosheng appeared and seemed to be very strong.

In this way, he felt a little more at ease and then he was even more reluctant to come forward.

Until the blood summons are activated.

The restlessness in his body made him unable to bear it anymore.

He is also a human race, so how can he be indifferent?

This time, he was really prepared to die in battle. Even if he and Lu Daosheng could not save the human race, he would have no regrets.

However, what he didn't expect was that Lu Daosheng was so strong.

Even in his heyday, he would not be able to kill a powerful man in the Supreme Realm.

All I can say is - it's stable.

And at this time, another powerful alien stood up.

I saw his body blood red, shining with a dark red light.

Everyone recognized it immediately.

This is a powerful divine blood clan, one of the strong tribes in the Chaos Realm. The strong tribes of their tribe have a deep attainment in blood paths, which makes people fear it.

"Your human race is exhausted, don't do these meaningless things."

The body of this powerful man from the Divine Blood Clan was shocked.

Countless tiny blood beads overflowed from the body and then continued to spread.

At the same time, a powerful aura unique to the Supreme Heaven was also revealed from his body.

The Supreme Heaven!

All the creatures present unconsciously held their breath.

Fights between the Supreme Heaven are rare.

If the human race had not fallen, they would not have come to the door.

It can be seen that the deterrent power of the Supreme Heaven is.

This is the first time that Tian Supreme takes action in a real sense.

Behind Lu Daosheng, the powerful man from the human race looked fearful, and it was obvious that the other party was very strong.

At this time, Lu Daosheng also looked at the Heavenly Supreme Powerful Man of the Divine Blood Clan.

In his eyes, there was still such an ancient well without waves.

I saw that Lu Daosheng took action.

He poked out his right hand and grabbed the powerful Divine Blood Clan in the distance.

For a moment, the field seemed to be silent for a moment.

The next moment, everyone present felt the blood in their bodies becoming restless.

"you!"

The powerful Divine Blood Clan in the distance had encountered something, and his eyes were suddenly covered with blood, staring at Lu Daosheng in the distance.

Immediately afterwards, blood squirted all over his body, and the next moment, there was a bang.

A bloody rain fell on the field.

Feeling the bloody smell in the air, the tribes could no longer calm down.

"Blood Dao, this is a blood-divine killing move!"

A powerful man from the Divine Blood Clan spoke in a trembling voice.

The Heavenly Supreme Powerful Man of the Divine Blood Clan actually died on the bloody killing move he was best at.

What an irony this is.

Lu Daosheng was pressing the faces of their divine blood clan to the ground and rubbing them!

But what can they do?

At this moment, except for the human race, no creature dared to look directly at Lu Daosheng.

This is the oppression of killing a powerful man of the Supreme Heaven in seconds.

"This is a strong man above the Supreme Heaven, retreat!"

In a short period of time, the tribes who were swearing to destroy the entire human race and fled here.

Of course, most of them just retreated into the darkness.

Looking at the gradually empty human ancestral land, everyone was in a daze.

Is this the end?

"Let's wait, thank you for helping me!!!"

The entire human race immediately knelt down on the ground, shouting loudly at Lu Daosheng with a pious look.

The Supreme Human Heaven behind Lu Daosheng looked embarrassed.

It turns out that he has nothing to do with it.

Then why should this existence call him with blood? Isn’t this a trick to him?

Facing the human race's thanks, Lu Daosheng did not respond, but just swept his eyes to all directions.

"Listen, any tribe that attacks our human race this time will come to our ancestral land to kowtow to admit its mistakes within one day, otherwise,

Lu Daosheng's voice was cold and contained extremely terrifying murderous intent.

The last two words were slowly spoken out, and the whole world was shaken.

"Extermination of the clan."

boom!

In an instant, the creatures in the Chaos Realm exploded.

Is this human race going to start a war against creatures in the entire Chaos Realm?

And the human race also looked unbelievable.

Some younger generations have a boiling blood and a wonderful expression.

Most of the human race's strong men hurriedly asked Lu Daosheng: "Senior, don't, now my human race really can't afford to be such trouble."

Now the first thing they think about is to recuperate and accumulate strength.

The human race that had just been severely damaged, how could it still have the strength to fight the entire Chaos Realm?

If it were the human race at its peak, there might be some opportunities.

But now,

It's hard to describe in one word.

If the war really starts, it is probably Lu Daosheng himself, and at most he will add the human race's supreme emperor who just appeared.

They don't want to see this scene.

You must know that the Supreme Heaven is not the highest realm of the Chaos Realm.

What I saw before was not the strongest side of those strong clans.

If these powerful clans really have all their foundations, it would be only a moment to destroy the human clan.

It’s really a bit uneasy to rely on Lu Daosheng himself alone.

At this time, several majestic voices came somewhere in the Chaos Realm.

"Your Excellency, are you really going to do this so terrible?"

"Hmph, I have some skills, I really don't know how high the world is."

"You alone, do you really think you can shake us?"

Hearing these words, Lu Daosheng sneered, "Destroy you, I am enough, let alone, who said I am the only one?"

Rumble!

At this moment, several roars suddenly came from outside the sky.

Immediately afterwards, the violent voice brought endless anger into the Chaos Realm.

"Which one who kills the god dares to attack our human race?!"

"I just ascended, not dead!!!"

"Even if I struggle to make my foundation damaged, I will pay the price!"
